question: What will be NVIDIA's forward guidance in its Q3 FY2027 earnings release? (Revenue)

calls.reasoning: Nvidia's next-quarter guide has run 1.115-1.145x the just-reported quarter's actual revenue (78/68.1, 91/81.6, 108/96.2). Recent beats of about 5% over guide imply Q3 actual of about $112-114B, which projects to a Q4 guide of about $126-130B. Recent guides have also landed 4-5% above pre-report consensus for the next quarter; Yahoo's Jan-2027 quarter consensus of about $124.5B implies about $129-131B. Upside: hyperscaler reacceleration in Q4, the Vera Rubin ramp (shipping since Aug 2026) and the 70% FY28 growth outlook. Downside: supply constraints, conservative guiding, China excluded. No Polymarket/Manifold/Kalshi market found.

calls.reasoning: NVIDIA's guides have run 1.115-1.145x the just-reported quarter (78/68.1, 91/81.6, 108/96.2), which is a $9.4-11.8B step. Q3 should come in around $112.5-114.5B given the 4.6-5.7% beats. The ratio method gives a guide of ~$126-130B; the dollar-step method gives ~$124-126B. Management expects hyperscaler growth to pick up in Q4 with the Vera Rubin ramp, but supply limits and the Q4 margin low cap the step. Consensus of ~$124.5B plus the typical ~4% guide-over-consensus points to ~$129B, though that partly double-counts. Median ~$127.3B. Tail above $135.5B is mainly China being added back. No human prediction market found.
calls.reconciliation: All three dossiers agree on the facts: guides of $78B, $91B and $108B; actuals of $68.1B, $81.6B and $96.2B; beats of 4.6% and 5.7%; Q4 consensus of ~$124.5B (from an unverified snippet). There was no factual dispute to settle, and this run had no web access. The remaining differences are judgment calls: the weight on upside above $135.5B (the runs said 5-10%) and the median ($127.5-128B). I added a cross-check the runs underweighted, the absolute dollar-step method ($9.4-11.8B over the prior actual), which points lower (~$125B). Against that sits management's call for Q4 reacceleration. Net, I set the median at $127.3B, slightly below the runs, and kept p_above at 5% because the upside needs a ~1.19x ratio or China being added back.

disagreements.verdict: 5%: needs ~1.19x Q3 actual, outside the recent 1.115-1.145 range, unless China is added back
$127.3B after weighing the dollar-step method against the Q4 reacceleration commentary
